تضطبنوا (form VIII)
# تَضْطَبِنُوا (taḍṭabinū) /tadˤ.tˤa.bi.nuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِضْطَبَنَ (iḍṭabana)
# تُضْطَبَنُوا (tuḍṭabanū) /tudˤ.tˤa.ba.nuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِضْطَبَنَ (iḍṭabana)
